<subject>Re: Our luncheon</subject>
<body>
Laura,

Ronald is with Crestview Advisory Group.  Can you coordinate with him the  
exact head count as we get closer.  Thanks!
</body>
<quoted>
----- Original Message -----
From: Ronald Prince <ronald.prince@crestviewadvisory.com>
Sent: Friday, May 3, 2024 6:29 AM
To: Bonnie Gardner <bonnie.gardner@cedarpointcap.com>
Subject: Re: Our luncheon

Bonnie,

The head count looks good for everyone (those that have responded). I have been waiting to hear back from all of the invitees.  I will be in touch about the exact head count whenever I receive responses.

Sorry for the delay,  
Ronald



From: Bonnie Gardner <bonnie.gardner@cedarpointcap.com>
Sent: Thursday, May 2, 2024 8:43 AM
To: Ronald Prince <ronald.prince@crestviewadvisory.com>
Cc: Connie Sutton <connie.sutton@cedarpointcap.com>, Christina Bell <christina.bell@cedarpointcap.com>
Subject: Our luncheon

Ronald,

You never got back to me on whether this date was good and the total head count.  Can youu please confirm this.  Thanks. ----- Forwarded by Bonnie Gardner on 5/2/2024 8:42 AM -----

	Bonnie Gardner
	4/12/2024 4:45 PM
		 
		 To: Ronald Prince <ronald.prince@crestviewadvisory.com>
		 cc: 
		 Subject: Our luncheon

Christina Bell had her assistant reserve Conference Room B on May 22 from 11:30 -2:00 for our luncheon.  Can you please confirm that that date is good for your group and also the total head count.  Laura will take care of ordering lunch for us.

Thanks!
</quoted>
